STEP 1 - Scene: A plated lunch/dinner: a slice (or two) of cheese pizza, a side of mixed green salad with pasta (penne-like) and cherry tomatoes, plus roasted/steamed broccoli and blistered cherry tomatoes.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A large rectangular-ish white plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 × (13)² ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: pizza slices (two pieces, cheese and tomato sauce, crust), mixed leafy greens (arugula/spring mix), pasta (penne, dressed), cherry tomatoes (roasted, plus raw halves), broccoli florets, black olives.

STEP 4 - Area (% of plate, sums to ~85%):
- Pizza (two slices): 25% ≈ 133 cm²
- Mixed leaves/arugula: 25% ≈ 133 cm²
- Pasta: 10% ≈ 53 cm²
- Broccoli: 8% ≈ 42 cm²
- Cherry tomatoes: 10% ≈ 53 cm²

- Dressing/oil sheen: ~5 g, counted separately

STEP 5 - Volume (area × height):
- Pizza: 133 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 200 ml
- Leaves: 133 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 400 ml
- Pasta: 53 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 106 ml
- Broccoli: 42 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 126 ml
- Tomatoes: 53 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 106 ml
- Olives: 11 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 11 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (volume × bulk density):
- Pizza: 200 × 0.9 ≈ 180 g
- Leaves: 400 × 0.15 ≈ 60 g
- Pasta: 106 × 0.8 ≈ 85 g

- Dressing/oil: ≈ 5 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Pizza: 180 g × 260 kcal/100 g ≈ 468 kcal
- Leaves: 60 g × 25 kcal/100 g ≈ 15 kcal
- Pasta: 85 g × 160 kcal/100 g ≈ 136 kcal
- Broccoli: 63 g × 34 kcal/100 g ≈ 21 kcal
- Tomatoes: 64 g × 20 kcal/100 g ≈ 13 kcal
- Olives: 10 g × 115 kcal/100 g ≈ 12 kcal
- Dressing/oil: 5 g × 800 kcal/100 g ≈ 40 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 547 g and ≈ 705 kcal. This fits a plate that is mostly covered with a pizza portion, a large salad, and pasta, which is plausible for a restaurant lunch plate.
